=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:334-346 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The exception-path `ms` calculation in `_run_semble_query` was reported as using a different pattern from the non-exception returns.
  WHY: One reviewer flagged an inconsistency, but others verified every return path uses the same inline calculation, so the claim is disputed.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:366-412 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The suite does not exercise `_run_semble_query` raising `OSError` or `subprocess.TimeoutExpired`, so the fallback telemetry branch is untested.
  WHY: Several reviewers noted the current mocks only cover completed-process failures, leaving the exception handler uncovered.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:320-324 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Integer truncation can log `ms=0` for sub-millisecond runs.
  WHY: Reviewers split on bug vs expected behavior, but the logged duration can be zero.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:41-53 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `_semble_elapsed_ms` can emit a negative duration when the end-time `date` read fails after a successful start-time read, or `0` when both reads fail.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed between hardening-only and runtime defect, but the merged issue is telemetry corruption or masked timing.
- tests/test_semble_helpers.py:138-166 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The test hardcodes `semble 0.1.3`, while `binary_matches_pin` matches any string containing `0.1.3`.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed whether that substring contract makes the test intentional, but the current assertion can miss version-format regressions.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:82-121 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Pre-query SEMBLE_FALLBACK paths omit `ms=` because the timer is started later.
  WHY: The reviewer treated this as informational/intentional; the omission is deliberate because no elapsed timer exists yet.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  PROBLEM: No test for the `except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired)` path in `_run_semble_query`.
  WHY: Factually correct coverage gap, but treated as a test-coverage note rather than a correctness bug.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:320-324
  PROBLEM: Claimed `ms=0` for sub-millisecond failures.
  WHY: Rejected because integer truncation to zero is expected behavior.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:41-53 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `_semble_elapsed_ms` can produce a negative elapsed value if the end-time `date` call fails after a successful start-time read; if both reads fail it returns `0`.
  WHY: Marked as a hardening concern with near-zero trigger probability rather than a correctness bug.
- tests/test_semble_helpers.py:138-166
  PROBLEM: Claimed the version test assumes an exact `semble --version` format.
  WHY: Rejected because `binary_matches_pin` uses substring matching, so the test is representative.
